matrix.subset_reason: Issue #284 / DR-010. This record does NOT supersede the full-matrix record 20260910-004925-e8e2e46 and does not re-derive any measurement that record already carries: the wrapped manifest's edit behind it is purely additive (three extra 'meas ... find ... at=1.45e-3' taps and the two measurements they feed, vref_spread_early and vref_converge), and no existing measurement, bound, deck parameter or sample point changed, so every per-corner value and the 16-of-45 vref_spread corner count in 20260910-004925-e8e2e46 remain the current full-matrix post-layout result. What this record adds is first post-layout evidence for the NEW vref_converge gate on the extracted DUT, and the two points are chosen for that: the sf process corner at both temperature extremes at 3.63 V, which is the tightest pair available -- sf/-40 degC/3.63 V is the global worst-case post-layout vref_spread corner of the whole 45-point matrix (16.746 mV), and sf/125 degC/3.63 V is a corner where vref_spread is exactly 0 V, so the new gate's 1e-5 V numerical tolerance is actually exercised on extracted parasitics rather than only on the schematic. It is deliberately NARROWER than this issue's schematic-side subset (4 points, sf and tt at the same two temperatures and the same supply) because a post-layout corner of this deck costs roughly twice a schematic one; the sf pair here is a strict subset of those 4 points, so the two records are directly comparable on the corners they share. The reason this is a subset at all is host capacity, stated plainly: this run is on a shared Linux x86_64 host under heavy concurrent load, where a single corner of this deck was still running after 38 minutes wall against the ~105 s the full-matrix record measured on the Darwin arm64 machine it was minted on, making a 45-point serial re-run impractical here -- a 4-point subset was started first and cut to this 2-point one for the same reason. This bench's default remains the full 45-point matrix; the --process/--temp/--supply/--subset-reason flags this run used were added to sim/bin/post_layout_common.py by the same issue precisely so that a subset re-run has to state its reason in the record instead of being done by editing the runner script. A full-matrix re-run on faster or uncontended hardware is tracked as its own issue.

spread_checks.note: Untrimmed output over process and temperature must move by more than 10 mV; a frozen value would indicate the .lib corner or .temp injection stopped taking effect.
